facts.fact_text: The applicant took part in the demonstration on 6 May 2012 at Bolotnaya Square.
According to the applicant, on 6 May 2012 she participated in the demonstration at Bolotnaya Square.
According to the applicant, she conducted herself peacefully at the demonstration at Bolotnaya Square on 6 May 2012.
When the marchers arrived at Bolotnaya Square on 6 May 2012, it transpired that barriers installed by the police had narrowed the entrance to the meeting venue.
The barriers installed by the police at Bolotnaya Square on 6 May 2012 allegedly restricted the space allocated for the meeting.
To control the crowd at Bolotnaya Square on 6 May 2012, a police cordon forced the protesters to remain within the barriers.
At 5.30 p.m. on 6 May 2012 the police ordered that the meeting at Bolotnaya Square finish early.
At 5.30 p.m. on 6 May 2012 the police began to disperse the participants of the meeting at Bolotnaya Square.
The applicant was arrested at the venue of the demonstration at Bolotnaya Square on 6 May 2012.
The applicant was accused of disobeying lawful orders of the police, an offence under Article 19.3 § 1 of the Code of Administrative Offences.
The administrative-offence record stated that during the event the applicant committed a breach of the rules on holding public events by breaking the police cordon.

The administrative-offence record stated that by breaking the police cordon the applicant prevented police officers from carrying out their service duties, in breach of Article 19.3 § 1 of the Code of Administrative Offences.
